access.heading: Access
access.description: Who may join this workspace, and what everyone must set up.
access.signupOpenHint: New accounts still wait for an admin's approval. Off, the sign-up page is closed.
access.requireMfaHint: Everyone must set up two-step verification before they can use the workspace.
access.requireMfaFirst: Set up your own authenticator app first, so turning this on does not lock you out.

reject.title: Reject this sign-up?
reject.message: {{name}} ({{email}}) will not get access, and their account is deleted. They can sign up again while sign-up is open.

disable.title: Disable this account?
disable.message: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and can't sign in until an admin enables the account again.

revokeSessions.title: Sign out everywhere?
revokeSessions.message: {{name}} is signed out on every device within half a minute, and can sign in again.

resetMfa.title: Reset this authenticator?
resetMfa.message: {{name}}'s authenticator app and lookup codes are removed, and they are signed out. Their next sign-in needs only a password or passkey.

recoveryLink.title: Recovery link for {{name}}
recoveryLink.description: Send this link to them privately. It signs them in and opens the page to set a new password.
recoveryLink.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
recoveryLink.expires: It works once, until {{time}}. Elysium keeps no copy.
recoveryLink.failed: The link could not be created.

conflicts.lastAdmin: The workspace must keep at least one active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
conflicts.accountState: That account changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
